notes: shape: Standard views and dedicated underside render inspected. The elongated rectangular canopy, deep fascia, perimeter trim and inset underside match the main reference construction. The underside is mostly flat, so panel seams and flush-light appearance must be verified after texturing.

texture_source: Red fascia, white stripe and gray trim are coherent, but dedicated underside render shows the reference framed flush lights reduced to numerous soft dark dots with an irregular duplicated layout. Retry texture on the accepted canopy shape to improve the visible soffit details.

texture_source: Second texture introduces large mottled white patches and unrelated stripe damage across the upper roof. Underside has some clearer framed lights but also duplicated and broken L-shaped marks. Use the third and final permitted texture attempt on the same approved shape.

texture_source: Third texture adds two large black torn-hole-like marks on the upper roof. The underside still duplicates fixtures and has extra dark marks. All three permitted texture attempts are exhausted; preserve the records and correct the first variant locally without another AI request.
